economic_thesis: Coins that persistently lead or lag the pure-crypto cross-section on both common-market up and down bars exhibit durable relative strength or weakness; requiring agreement across three time blocks should preserve that spread through bull, bear, and chop while a weekly neutral book controls cost at the mechanism level.

expected_regime_roles.bear: The neutral book owns coins with durable relative resilience on down as well as up bars and shorts persistent laggards without requiring a market-direction forecast.
expected_regime_roles.bull: The long sleeve owns persistent cross-tape relative leaders and the short sleeve retains persistent laggards while net exposure remains zero.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Three-block agreement and cross-tape shrinkage suppress transient one-window winners, reversal noise, and tape-dependent rankings.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Owns the highest returned durability ranks, requiring sustained peer outperformance across market directions and time blocks.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Shorts the lowest returned durability ranks, requiring sustained peer underperformance across market directions and time blocks.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Per-bar ranks, smaller-magnitude cross-tape scoring, broad neutral sleeves, 0.36 gross, and a 0.025 coin cap limit scale and beta concentration; profitability remains an empirical gate.

falsifier: Reject if this exact no-control core fails any official central-development threshold: net Sharpe at least 0.75, positive annualized return, Calmar at least 0.40, maximum drawdown at most 0.30, doubled-cost Sharpe at least 0.35, positive doubled-cost return, trial-adjusted probability positive at least 0.90, four profitable folds, positive-quarter fraction at least 0.55, worst-regime Sharpe at least -0.25, and at least three positive regime Sharpes; or fails any stricter bull, bear, chop, role, sleeve, concentration, A5 coverage, or score-IC gate. Controls, neighbors, and private data cannot rescue it.
mechanism: Every seven days, rank each eligible coin's return on each of 126 completed 8-hour bars. Reward relative leaders and laggards whose mean ranks agree across common-market up/down tapes and across three non-overlapping 42-bar blocks; shrink tape disagreement and time dispersion; final-rank once at A5; then construct a broad, equal-dollar, exactly neutral long/short book from only the returned scores.
risk_policy_plan: Run only the exact disabled no-control second-pivot reference first. No risk control, stop, neighbor, diagnostic, or private ticket is authorized unless that reference passes the complete official central-development gate and every stricter broad alpha, regime, role, fold, quarter, sleeve, concentration, score-IC, and coverage gate. Controls cannot repair a failed mechanism.
selection_metric: Noncompensatory eligibility first: the complete official central-development gate and every stricter no-control and score-evidence gate must pass. No controlled or neighboring result can substitute for the exact reference.
